description: This file implements a backend server component for integrating Playwright with a Visual Studio Code extension, managing browser contexts, connections, and tool commands.

classes.name: VSCodeProxyBackend
classes.description: A backend server class that manages connections, tools, and browser contexts for Playwright integration with VS Code.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend with server, client version, and roots, setting up the transport and client.

methods.name: listTools
methods.description: Returns a list of available tools including the context switch tool.

methods.name: callTool
methods.description: Calls a specified tool with arguments, handling the context switch tool separately.

methods.name: serverClosed
methods.description: Handles server closure by closing the current client.

methods.name: onContext
methods.description: Sets the current browser context and listens for its close event.

methods.name: _getDebugControllerURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL for the debug controller if available.

methods.name: _callContextSwitchTool
methods.description: Handles the logic for connecting/disconnecting browsers or retrieving debug URL.

methods.name: _defineContextSwitchTool
methods.description: Defines the tool used for connecting to a browser in VS Code.

methods.name: _setCurrentClient
methods.description: Sets the current client with a given transport, closing previous client if any.
